title: The Charter Skipper — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 104bpm walking bass brushed drums character portrait unhurried Spanish French language learning Pete Pelican
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
He used to nail down roofs in the Western Australian heat
Now he reads the swell before the harbour and the fleet
The same hands that drove the nails now turn the wheel
The charter skipper knows the difference in the feel

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
Él clavaba los techos bajo el sol australiano
[He used to nail down roofs under the Australian sun]
Ahora lee las olas con ojo veterano
[Now he reads the swells with a veteran's eye]
Las mismas manos que ponían clavos, ahora guían el timón
[The same hands that drove nails, now guide the helm]
El capitán del charter sabe la diferencia en la sensación
[The charter skipper knows the difference in the feel]

[Chorus — English]
The charter skipper on the morning run
Reads the weather and the water and the angle of the sun
The charter skipper used to be up on the tiles
Now he's out past Rottnest doing nautical miles
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Il clouait les toits sous la chaleur australienne
[He used to nail roofs under the Australian heat]
Maintenant il lit la houle et pilote sa sirène
[Now he reads the swell and pilots his vessel]
Les mêmes mains qui clouaient dirigent maintenant le gouvernail
[The same hands that nailed now steer the helm]
Le capitaine charter connaît la mer sans détail
[The charter skipper knows the sea without details]

[Outro — All three languages]
Charter skipper knows… El capitán charter sabe… Le capitaine charter sait
From the roof to the water — Del techo al agua — Du toit à l'eau
That's my boy
